interface.shortDescription: Personal plugin scaffold for adding skills as needs come up.
interface.longDescription: estack is a personal plugin scaffold shared by Claude Code and Codex. The skill directory starts empty on purpose. Add small skills under plugins/estack/skills only when a real workflow need appears, then refresh the plugin install with scripts/refresh.sh.
